qr.scan_to_pay: Scan with any UPI app and pay
qr.waiting_vpa: Waiting — confirm when the money arrives
qr.vpa_hint: Check the soundbox, bank SMS or the customer's payment success screen before marking it received.
qr.amount_mismatch: Customer paid {{received}}, but the bill was {{expected}}. Please check.
qr.invalid_vpa: The shop UPI ID is not valid. Fix it in UPI & payment setup.

allocation.auto_hint: Change any amount to choose bills yourself
allocation.load_failed: Could not load the pending bills.
allocation.none_in: No pending bills. The full amount will be kept as advance.
allocation.none_out: No pending bills for this supplier. The full amount will be kept as advance.

entry.receive_hint: Money from a customer for their dues or as advance
entry.pay_hint: Money paid to a supplier for their bills or as advance
entry.to_shift_hint: This cash will be counted in the open shift of this counter.
entry.to_shift_off_hint: Not taken at this counter — it will not be counted in the shift.

cancel.hint: {{amount}} will be reversed in the accounts and the bills it settled will be due again.

detail.no_allocations: Not applied to any bill — kept as advance.

cancel_via.sales_tender: This was paid with a bill. To undo it, cancel the bill.
cancel_via.credit_note_settlement: This is a return refund. To undo it, cancel the credit note.
cancel_via.debit_note_settlement: This is a purchase return settlement. To undo it, cancel the debit note.

list.hint: All money received from customers and paid to suppliers
list.search_placeholder: Number, UTR, cheque no. or name
list.empty_hint: When customers pay their dues or you pay suppliers, record it here. Bills paid at the counter appear automatically.

upi.hint: Every UPI QR and link, live. Apply payments nobody has used yet.
upi.unapplied_explain: This money reached your account but is not linked to any bill or customer (for example, the bill was abandoned or the customer paid twice). Apply it to a bill or a customer so the khata is correct.
upi.cancel_hint: The customer will not be able to pay with this QR any more. If they already paid, it will show up as paid.
upi.confirm_hint: Reference {{code}}, created {{time}}. Do this only after you see the money in your account.
upi.utr_hint: From the customer's payment screen or your bank SMS
upi.amount_received_hint: Change only if the customer paid a different amount
upi.apply_hint: Paid by {{payer}}. Choose where this money should go.
upi.to_customer_hint: Settles their oldest bills; the rest stays as advance
upi.excess_to_advance: {{amount}} more than the bill due will be kept as the customer's advance.
upi.walk_in_excess: This walk-in bill's due is less than the payment. Choose the customer instead, so the extra can be kept as advance.
upi.date_hint: Leave empty to use the day it was paid

empty.pending: No QR is waiting for payment
empty.pending_hint: QRs shown at the counter or sent as links appear here until they are paid.
empty.unapplied_hint: Every rupee received by UPI is linked to a bill or a customer.
empty.paid: No UPI payments on this day
empty.paid_hint: Payments received through UPI QRs and links will be listed here.
empty.closed_hint: QRs that expire, fail or are cancelled are listed here.

settings.page_hint: Choose how customers pay you by UPI and where the money goes.
settings.option_vpa_tagline: Free with your UPI ID — cashier confirms
settings.option_vpa_point_free: No charges — money goes straight to your bank
settings.option_vpa_point_offline: QR with the exact amount at the counter and on bills, even without internet
settings.option_vpa_point_manual: Cashier marks it received after seeing the soundbox or SMS
settings.option_rzp_tagline: Automatic confirmation — Razorpay charges a fee
settings.option_rzp_point_auto: Bill completes by itself when the customer pays
settings.option_rzp_point_links: Payment links for khata dues on WhatsApp
settings.option_rzp_point_fee: Razorpay takes a small fee per payment (see your Razorpay plan)
settings.option_rzp_point_onprem: Needs internet. Without a public address Kadai checks each payment every few seconds.
settings.rzp_upgrade_hint: Automatic UPI confirmation is part of a higher plan.
settings.accounts_hint: The default account is used for QRs at the counter and on bills.
settings.empty_hint: Add your shop's UPI ID to show a QR with the exact amount at billing. It takes a minute and costs nothing.
settings.no_default_hint: No default account is set. Choose one so the counter knows which QR to show.
settings.deactivate_hint: It will not be used for new payments. Past payments stay as they are, and you can turn it on again.
settings.deactivate_default_hint: This is the default account. After deactivating, choose another default so the counter can show a QR.
settings.make_default_hint: Used for QRs at the counter and on bills of this store
settings.store_hint: All stores, or only one branch
settings.settlement_hint: The bank account this money reaches. Leave empty for the default bank account.

upi.dialog_hint: Find your UPI ID in your bank or UPI app (Profile → UPI ID). A business/merchant UPI ID is best.
upi.payee_hint: Shown in the customer's UPI app — usually the shop name (up to 50 letters)
upi.mcc_hint: Set from your business type; change only if your bank gave you another one
upi.test_empty: Type the UPI ID and name to see a ₹1 test QR here.
upi.test_steps: Scan this with your own UPI app. It should show “{{payee}}”. Pay ₹1 to be sure — it comes to your own account.
upi.test_step_scan: Open any UPI app on your phone and scan this QR.
upi.test_step_name: Check that it shows “{{payee}}” as the name.
upi.test_step_pay: Pay ₹1 — it comes back to your own account. If it works, customers can pay too.
upi.test_format_ok: The UPI ID format is correct

razorpay.dialog_hint: In the Razorpay Dashboard open Account & Settings → API Keys and generate a key. Copy the key ID and secret here.
razorpay.test_hint: Practice with Razorpay test keys — no real money
razorpay.webhook_secret_hint: A password you choose; enter the same one in the Razorpay webhook setting
razorpay.webhook_secret_set: A webhook secret is saved. Type a new one only to change it.
razorpay.payee_hint: Name on the QR; leave empty to use the shop name
razorpay.connected_hint: One last step: tell Razorpay where to send payment updates.
razorpay.webhook_title: Set up the webhook in Razorpay
razorpay.webhook_step_open: In the Razorpay Dashboard open Account & Settings → Webhooks → Add new webhook.
razorpay.webhook_step_secret: Enter the same webhook secret you saved here.
razorpay.webhook_step_events: Tick the events below and save.
razorpay.no_webhook_secret: No webhook secret saved — webhooks will be ignored until you add one. Kadai still checks payments every few seconds.
razorpay.no_public_url: This Kadai Server has no public internet address, so Razorpay cannot send updates to it. That is fine: Kadai checks each payment every few seconds.
